_note_llm_catalog: Optional. Set `llm_catalog.refresh_url` to the published master llm.json so the Models page's 'Refresh Builtin Models' button can pull, validate, and install the latest built-in providers (previous kept as llm.json.bak). Omit to disable the action. The URL must be https on a public host without credentials, and the download refuses any address that is not public; set `allow_insecure_source` to true only for an internal mirror (plain http or a private network). Loopback, link-local and cloud metadata hosts are always refused.
_note_drift: Optional. LLM drift replay-evaluation runner + retention controls. `eval_max_consecutive_failures` auto-suspends a surface's scheduled evaluation after N consecutive failed runs (0 disables); `eval_session_timeout_secs` caps each replayed session so one wedged upstream can't hang a run. Cost: a replay is a real upstream call billed to the surface and metered against its usage limits, so `eval_max_run_cost_usd` caps the provider spend one run may consume before it stops part-way (null = no appliance ceiling; a surface's Drift Harness can override it). Retention: `max_runs_per_surface` / `max_sessions_per_surface` cap how many run-history entries / captured indicative sessions are kept per surface (enforced on write); `max_run_age_days` / `max_session_age_days` optionally drop records older than N days (null = no age limit; enforced on write and by a periodic sweep so idle surfaces are pruned too).
